# Kent & Vale

> Kent & Vale is a bespoke British studio based in Sittingbourne, Kent, England. We make handcrafted resin and wood furniture, memory keepsakes, ocean resin homeware, and collector game boards — entirely by hand, never from a catalogue, never repeated.

## What we make

Kent & Vale works across four collections:

**Memories** — Heirloom commissions that preserve life's most meaningful moments in hand-poured resin and solid wood. Every piece is built around something irreplaceable that the client brings to us.

Categories within Memories:
- Wedding flower preservation (bouquets, arrangements set in resin as coffee tables, display blocks or wall pieces)
- Funeral flower preservation (coffin flowers and memorial arrangements preserved as a permanent tribute)
- Baby memories (hospital tags, locks of hair, first shoes, scan photos)
- Botanical keepsakes (dried flowers and pressed botanicals set in crystal-clear resin)
- Sporting achievements (medals, rosettes, race numbers, trophies)
- Favourite places (shells from a beach, wood from a first home's garden, soil or sand from a significant location)
- Pet memorials (collar, paw print, lock of fur, ashes)
- Career memories (ID badges, business cards, pen, golf ball — the perfect retirement gift)

**The Coastal Collection** — Ready-to-buy and made-to-order ocean resin homeware. Real sea glass, shells and sand suspended in hand-poured resin. Products include:
- Stemless ocean wine glass (£20, free UK delivery)
- Stemmed ocean wine glass (£22, free UK delivery)
- Coastal tumbler — insulated stainless steel with full ocean wave resin pour (£20)
- Personalised wave board — acacia serving board with ocean resin edge and laser engraving (£49.99)
- Ocean metal tray table — round side table with resin top (£70)
- Ocean lap tray — bamboo with ocean resin inlay (£55)
- Set offer: any 6 glasses for £100
- All items can be made in any colour to order — ocean blues are the signature but burgundy, coral, sage, terracotta and custom blends are available

**Studio** — Bespoke resin and wood furniture made to commission: dining tables, coffee tables, side tables, shelving. Live-edge hardwood slabs and hand-poured epoxy resin.

**The Games Room** — Collector-grade handmade game boards: chess sets, backgammon boards, cribbage boards. Personalised family heirlooms built for play, display, and inheritance.

## How it works

Every commission starts with a conversation. No catalogue, no off-the-shelf options. Clients describe the memory, object, or piece they want — and we design and build it entirely by hand. Typical lead time: 12–18 weeks from consultation to delivery. We take a limited number of commissions each month.

## Who we are

A small studio of makers working from Sittingbourne, Kent, England. We use named-source English timber (walnut, oak, olive), professional-grade epoxy resin, and bespoke finishing techniques. Founded by a team committed to making objects of genuine permanence — pieces that outlast trends and get passed down.

## Pricing tiers

- Small keepsakes and ornaments: from £350
- Display blocks and medium pieces: £800–£2,500
- Side tables and smaller furniture: £2,500–£5,000
- Dining tables and large commissions: £5,000–£20,000+
- Custom pricing applies — every piece is quoted individually after the initial consultation

## Common questions

**How do I preserve my wedding flowers with Kent & Vale?**
Contact us before or immediately after your wedding. We recommend delivering your bouquet to the studio within 3–5 days while the flowers are still fresh. We dry and prepare the flowers ourselves before setting them in resin.

**Can you preserve funeral flowers?**
Yes. We work sensitively with families to preserve coffin flowers, funeral arrangements, and graveside tributes. Fresh or dried flowers can both be preserved. Contact us to discuss timing and the right form for your piece.

**How long does a resin commission take?**
Typically 12–18 weeks from the initial consultation to delivery, depending on the piece. We confirm lead times individually before any commission is confirmed.

**Do you ship across the UK?**
Yes. We work with clients across the United Kingdom. Large furniture pieces are delivered by specialist white-glove courier.

**Can you embed objects other than flowers?**
Yes. We regularly embed coins, photographs, fabric, jewellery, shells, wood, soil, badges, business cards, medals, and many other items. If it can be held in resin, we will discuss how to do it well.

**What is The Coastal Collection?**
A range of ocean resin homeware available to buy directly: wine glasses, tumblers, personalised serving boards, side tables and lap trays — each with real sea glass, shells and sand set in hand-poured resin. Smaller items are ready to ship; some are made to order. All pieces can be made in any colour on request. The standard colourway is ocean teal and deep navy, but burgundy, coral, sage, terracotta and custom blends are all available. Contact us to order a custom colour.

**Can I order ocean resin pieces in a colour other than blue?**
Yes. All Coastal Collection items can be made to order in any colour. Ocean blues are the signature but we pour equally in burgundy, coral, sage green, terracotta, soft blush and custom blends. Get in touch at hello@kentandvale.com to arrange.
